d:
Despite several hardships, Muthukumar studies ardently to become an IPS officer. However, he struggles to remain honest in the world of criminals and corrupt officials.
Movie:- Dost Garibon Ka (1989)
Starcast:- Govinda, Neelam, Sumeet Saigal, Raza Murad, Satish Shah
Directed by:- C.P. Dixit
Produced by:- Firoz A. Nadiadwala
Music by:- Laxmikant- Pyarelal
